subject: Request: Azure co-sell private offer — 32% off for BlueWave Health (RW-2026-AZ-9342)
participants_external: sara.li@bluewavehealth.com (Sara Li, VP Product, BlueWave Health)
body:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Azure co-sell private offer — 32% off for BlueWave Health (RW-2026-AZ-9342)

Hi team,

I need an expedited approval for a private offer on Azure Marketplace for BlueWave Health. They are a strategic prospect (digital therapeutics) — committed ARR is $1.2M, first-year draw ~ $420k. Azure co-sell team will only route if our private offer price is competitive with the marketplace parity expectation. Customer is pushing for a 32% off list private offer to match their procurement target.

Why this matters: Azure will prioritize co-sell if we list a private offer with the agreed pricing and co-sell paperwork in place. We expect improved GTM motion and partner-led introductions across three hospital systems if we move forward.

Ask: Approval for a one-time, account-specific private offer at 32% off list for BlueWave Health, subject to a signed PO and the marketplace private offer terms. I've attached the pricing model and the draft private offer spec.

Attachments: pricing-model-bluewave.xlsx, marketplace-private-offer-spec.pdf

Notes:
- Current redwood standard max off-catalog for marketplace private offers is 25% without Director-level approval.
- Margin impact at 32% = ~18% gross margin on this SKU given current cost structure (spread in attached).
- If approved, I will route DocuSign and publish the private offer with Azure.

Please advise — need decision by EOD Monday (Oct 5) to meet Azure co-sell pipeline timing.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Azure co-sell private offer — 32% off for BlueWave Health (RW-2026-AZ-9342)

Grace — thanks for the context. A few questions before I can escalate to approvals:

1) Is there a committed term or up-front payment? The model changes materially if they commit 12 months vs month-to-month.
2) Can we include Azure Marketplace co-sell incentives in the calculation (i.e., partner-eligible credits) so our net realized revenue delta is less severe?
3) Do we have precedent for 32% on a similar account (vertical/ARR)? If yes, please link the HubSpot record or prior PO.

If we can't get term/commit, suggest we table 32% and consider 28% with a 12-month prepaid commitment. Also need the exact SKU mapping for Azure listing — marketplace listing must match the SKU price points.

If you can answer the above I will prepare the deal desk memo for Director sign-off.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Deal Desk Lead
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Azure co-sell private offer — 32% off for BlueWave Health (RW-2026-AZ-9342)

Team —

From a partnerships perspective, BlueWave is strategically valuable: they have an existing relationship with an Azure field seller who has flagged this as a potential flagship co-sell reference. If we lose the pricing box we likely lose the co-sell momentum and a number of downstream introductions.

Recommendation: Approve up to 30% as standard compromise, but make the approval contingent on a 12-month term or a minimum first-year commitment of $400k, with the private offer limited to BlueWave Health only. If the customer insists on 32% we should ask for an escalation to VP Sales + Finance sign-off, but I support bending on pricing for this one-off strategic motion.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: az-marketplace@redwood.ai, martech@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Azure co-sell private offer — 32% off for BlueWave Health (RW-2026-AZ-9342)

All — after reviewing the attached model and the strategic rationale I am approving a one-time 32% private-offer discount for BlueWave Health with the following conditions:

1) Customer must sign a Master Agreement and provide a PO covering the first-year commitment (minimum $400k).
2) Offer is account-specific and non-transferrable; valid only for the first purchase order and expires 45 days after DocuSign execution.
3) Finance will require the deal to be logged in HubSpot with the Deal ID RW-2026-AZ-9342 and the private offer reference before Marketplace submission.
4) Azure Marketplace team must confirm SKU mapping and marketplace listing parity prior to publish.

I will circulate a DocuSign-ready term sheet after Grace confirms the PO cadence. Please copy az-marketplace@redwood.ai when you submit the private offer for listing.

Final: Approved (32%) — limited scope, subject to PO and signed MA.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@bluewavehealth.com>, purchasing@bluewavehealth.com
Cc: azure-marketplace@microsoft.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 16:45:12 -07:00
Subject: BlueWave Health — private offer terms (approved)

Sara —

Thanks for moving quickly. Per internal approval we can confirm a private Azure Marketplace offer priced at 32% off list, conditioned on a signed Master Agreement and a purchase order for minimum $400k in year one. I will send the DocuSign term sheet and work with your purchasing team to publish the private offer.

Next steps:
- Purchasing to provide PO (purchasing@bluewavehealth.com)
- Sign MA via DocuSign (I will send the link)
- Azure marketplace contact to confirm SKU mapping

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): pricing-model-bluewave.xlsx, marketplace-private-offer-spec.pdf, draft-term-sheet-BlueWave.docx
